title: Gym Accessories
tagline: Weightlifting belts and straps, built for load.
blurb: Weightlifting belts and training straps, stitched from heavy-duty leather for repeated, high-load use.
heroIntro: Gym accessories put leather under real, repeated load - so our weightlifting belts and straps are cut from heavier-weight hides and reinforced at every stress point. It's the same tannery-to-finished-product control we apply everywhere else, specified for a different kind of durability.
